notes.title: Steam Awards Nominations Now Open!
notes.notes:
Nominate SAMURAI WARRIORS 4 DX for the Steam Awards!

We hope you can nominate SAMURAI WARRIORS 4 DX for " Better With Friends Award ". 
Of course, if you think other categories are more suitable, then please feel free to nominate it there! 

The nominations will be open until 10AM (PT) on December 4th. 

We hope you’re all enjoying SAMURAI WARRIORS 4 DX!

notes.title: Acquiring DLC Weapons
notes.notes: DLC weapons can be obtained at the Shop after clearing "Legend of a Land United" and "Secret History."

notes.title: Update Details for Ver. 1.0.1.0 (6/14/2024)
notes.notes:
• Fixed a bug making it impossible for players to progress when certain cutscenes played.
• Fixed a bug preventing transparent bitmap images from loading properly.
  (Some transparent bitmap images will not load.)
• Fixed a bug in which text was displayed incorrectly in the English version of the game.
• Fixed a bug restricting selectable resolution settings.
• Added the option to skip cutscenes from the first playthrough.
• Fixed a bug in which soldier colors were incorrect.
• Fixed other minor bugs.

notes.title: Screen Resolution Settings
notes.notes:
If the resolution is set to a low quality on startup or if you are unable to select certain resolutions like 4K, please restart the application and set the resolution through the following steps.
1. Select Dojo.
2. Select Settings.
3. Select Graphics.
4. Set the resolution via the Resolution category.
